characters.summary: Miles 'Tails' Prower fights using his twin tails for flight and propulsion, alongside various custom technological gadgets and explosives. He is exceptionally intelligent, serving as Sonic's mechanic and tactical planner while utilizing custom weaponry and vehicles in combat.
weaknesses: Relies heavily on equipment and mechanical devices
Prone to hesitation or self-doubt when separated from mentors or friends
limitations: Flight endurance is limited by fatigue when using tails continuously
Physical strength in close combat is lower compared to power-type characters like Knuckles

sources.supports: Overview of Tails' abilities, twin tails flight, mechanical genius, and general combat style.

campaignTags.claim: Tails can use his twin tails to fly freely through the air.
Innate ability to fly using his two tails as helicopter rotors.
Master pilot of the Tornado biplane and various other vehicles.
Exceptional mechanical genius who creates advanced technology and weapons.
Utilizes a variety of custom high-tech gadgets in battle.

unknowns: Exact top flight speed without mechanical enhancements.

characters.continuity: Sonic the Hedgehog series (Classic / Mania / 3 & Knuckles)
characters.summary: Super Tails is an invincible empowered state achieved by collecting all seven Chaos Emeralds, accompanied by invincible Flicky birds that attack nearby enemies automatically.

mechanisms: Automatic destruction of nearby foes by companion Flickies

weaknesses: Time-limited transformation dependent on Ring count
Loses form when Rings are depleted
characters.formDifferences: Gains absolute invulnerability, glowing golden fur, flight speed boost, and an escort of invincible Super Flickies that obliterate nearby enemies.

sources.supports: Super Tails mechanics, Chaos Emerald requirement, and Flicky summon ability.

unknowns: Exact duration of the transformation outside of gameplay mechanics.

characters.summary: Thrall is a powerful Orc shaman and warrior who wields the legendary hammer Doomhammer and commands the elemental forces of nature, including lightning, wind, and earth.
weaknesses: Vulnerable when spiritually disconnected from the elements
Dependent on his weapon for certain focused strikes
limitations: Elemental cooperation can be lost or diminished in blighted or unnatural environments

sources.supports: Thrall's background as Warchief, Shamanistic powers, elemental control, and Doomhammer usage.

notableResults.note: Defeated Garrosh in mak'gora using elemental shamanism.

campaignTags.claim: Commands powerful lightning and chain lightning spells.
Casts elemental spells and healing incantations.

unknowns: Extent of his shamanic powers after the events of Battle for Azeroth.

characters.summary: Tifa Lockhart is a master martial artist who fights using her fists and feet, employing high-speed combos, staggering strikes, and powerful limit break techniques.
limitations: Melee-exclusive combat range without projectile Materia equipped

sources.supports: Tifa's fighting style, martial arts techniques, limit breaks, and magic usage.

notableResults.note: Fought alongside party members against Shinra executives.

campaignTags.claim: Equips and casts magic via Materia.
Casts elemental and healing spells through Materia slots.

unknowns: Exact upper limit of physical strength scaling.

characters.summary: Toad is a swift and agile Mushroom Kingdom resident who relies on speed, items, and team support in battles and sports events.
weaknesses: Low physical durability compared to heavier fighters like Bowser
Relies on external items for offensive escalation
limitations: Lacks innate supernatural offensive powers without items

sources.supports: Toad's physical traits, general capabilities in spin-offs, and agility.

campaignTags.claim: Utilizes various Mario universe power-up items.

unknowns: Individual combat feats outside of group sports and platforming assistance.

characters.summary: Tom Nook is a business-minded raccoon who manages real estate and economic infrastructure. He does not engage in traditional combat, instead utilizing financial leverage and contracts.
weaknesses: Completely lacks combat training or offensive physical attacks
limitations: Non-combatant in all official gameplay contexts

sources.supports: Tom Nook's role as a store owner and loan provider with no combat background.

characters.summary: Wreck-It Ralph is a massive, immensely strong arcade game villain who specializes in smashing obstacles, structures, and opponents with his giant hands.
limitations: Lacks ranged attacks or magical abilities

sources.supports: Ralph's immense physical strength, durability, and role as a wrecking antagonist.
